job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain large-scale AI models using Python on GCP Cloud Platform.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate data flow pipelines into existing systems using Data Flow and BigQuery.
Develop scalable and efficient algorithms for processing large datasets in Dataproc clusters.
Troubleshoot issues related to model performance, data quality, and system reliability.

Job Requirements :

4-9 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence Engineering or a related field.
Strong proficiency in Python programming language with expertise in machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services including Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, BigQuery, Data Flow etc.
